objective: Provide a capability-scoped local Prediction project executor that can build, test and manage the user-level project without granting root, live trading, paid, wallet, credential-write or autonomous remote-Git-write capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: A safe task can execute repository-owned Python in an isolated task worktree and return evidence to ChatGPT
Project-file writes are limited to the task worktree or task temp root for child Python
sudo/root, shell=True, credential paths, arbitrary external network and non-Prediction service management are blocked
git push and remote/credential Git mutation are blocked while local status/diff/add/commit/branch operations remain available
Prediction user services and journals are accessible only through explicit capabilities
task provenance records task id, exact spec hash, remote commit, pinned source commit, model, intelligence tier and outcome
duplicate task IDs do not execute twice and ambiguous/failing tasks are not silently retried
deterministic negative tests cover privilege, path, Git, service and network boundaries
existing live_trading=false, paid_actions=false and wallet_actions=false guardrails remain intact
non_goals: No live order submission or cancellation
No wallet, crypto or fund movement
No autonomous git push, GitHub publication or remote ref mutation
No weakening of scientific NO_PROVEN_EDGE gates
No change to collector recovery or evidence/provenance research logic
independent_verification: Final acceptance requires an independent Tier-A review plus deterministic self-tests and a live harmless end-to-end canary; until then status remains REQUIRES_HIGH_INTELLIGENCE_REVIEW.
rollback_plan: Disable use of the PROJECT executor, revert the executor/guard commits, and retain existing BRIDGE_PING plus DEV task tunnel; no live-trading component is modified.
cleanup_plan: Task worktrees and temp directories are bounded under ~/.local/share/prediction-project-executor; evidence/state is retained under ~/.local/state/prediction-project-executor and may only be cleaned by an explicit maintenance task.
